_comment: Curated notes for the examples gallery (website/docs/examples/index.md is generated from this file, each project's game.json and its scenes). Order here is the gallery order. image/video are paths under website/docs/assets/. features are added to the ones detected from the scenes.

tidebreak_isle.description: An island cove at golden hour, built by an agent crew with the engine's own tools. An erosion-sculpted island with wet sand where the swash reaches, an FFT sea that shoals over the seabed, instanced palms and dune grass, a fort, a brig at anchor and a campfire with volumetric fire. Its hero camera moves ship as sequences, ready for the movie render queue.

neon_requiem.description: A rain-soaked neon avenue at midnight with nearly six hundred lights evaluated by clustered lighting, reflective puddles, a monorail, holograms and animated pedestrians (a CC-BY glTF sample character). The city kit was generated in Blender through the DCC bridge.

ashen_peaks.description: A monastery valley at a misty sunrise: eroded alpine terrain, forests that turn into octahedral impostors in the distance, lantern-lit stairs, volumetric fires and a mirror lake. It is the scene the foliage impostor measurements in the manual come from.

berrybrook.description: A cozy berry farm: plant a row, harvest ripe berries, sell them at the stand and chat with the neighbours. Terrain with painted fields, foliage, a pond, a UI with a hotbar and a dialogue, and a miniature tilt-shift camera for its establishing shot.

meridian_accord.description: A grand strategy map of a fictional continent: a terrain with a draped map overlay and map modes, clouds composited below the camera, nearly a hundred world-text labels, fronts and units, and a full UI with nation panels and news events.

gloamwater.description: A 2D metroidvania in a drowned kingdom: painted parallax layers, sprites with flipbook animation, a tilemap, 2D lights with soft shadows and halos, particles, dialogue and a UI, all rendered by the same engine as the 3D worlds.

chancellors_desk.description: A narrative political drama played across one desk on one rainy night: documents and decrees built with the UI system, a branching dialogue script, lamplight, and rain on the window.

smugglers_cove.description: A pirate cove at golden hour built from CC0 photoscanned models and textures and an HDRI sky, with an FFT ocean and a volumetric campfire. The movie render queue's performance figures were measured on it.

hidden_alley.description: A rainy neo-noir alley assembled from CC0 photoscans under a night HDRI, with puddles of real reflective water, rain particles and fire.

namaqua_canyon.description: A desert canyon at sunset with a covered jeep and a campfire: CC0 photoscanned rocks and props under an HDRI sky.

abyss.description: Underwater horror three hundred meters down: a lit submarine, drifting bioluminescent jellyfish, kelp and ruins, with a hundred behaviors animating the life around you.

cyber_alley.description: A neon alley in the rain: glowing signs, wet reflective pavement and about two hundred behaviors bringing the street to life.

frostlight.description: Cozy exploration under an aurora: snowy pines, an igloo and penguins heading home.

harvest_fair.description: A family park at golden hour with a Ferris wheel, string lights, stalls and pumpkins under an atmospheric sky.

hearthside.description: A log cabin on a snowy night: firelight, a decorated tree and snow outside the window.

hollow_manor.description: Horror exploration: a lantern in the fog, a graveyard and a manor that should be empty.

zen_garden.description: A meditative art game: raked sand, a koi pond, bamboo and falling petals in soft morning haze.

toy_kart_rally.description: Kart racing at dusk: four karts on an oval under floodlights, with a crowd waiting for fireworks.

star_lancer.description: A space shoot 'em up above a ringed giant, driven by more than three hundred behaviors.

neon_drift.description: A synthwave arena shooter: one ship, endless drones, a grid floor and a setting sun.

cloudhopper.description: A 3D platformer across six floating islands with coins, mushrooms and a castle; the camera follows the hero.

sky_dash.description: A side-scrolling platformer: run, hop and grab every coin. It is the project the shipping guide packages into a standalone macOS app.

sky_village.title: Sky Village
sky_village.pitch: A floating village above the clouds.
sky_village.description: A floating village diorama with a windmill, a lighthouse and an airship, small enough to read in one sitting.

hello_sky.title: Hello Sky
hello_sky.pitch: The smallest scene that shows the loop.
hello_sky.description: The starter scene used throughout the getting-started guide: a floating island, a tower, a cloud and a few behaviors. Small enough to read in full and the default target of the CLI examples.
